fetches.notes: Current: 18. Supported: 18, 17, 16, 15, 14. PostgreSQL 16 is supported but not the current major.

excerpt_verbatim: We recommend that users always run the current minor release associated with their major version.

The PostgreSQL Global Development Group supports a major version for 5 years after its initial release. After this, a final minor version will be released and the software will then be unsupported (end-of-life).

summary: PostgreSQL 16 の現行マイナー版は 16.15。コミュニティ保守の最終リリース (EOL) は 2028-11-09。15 は 15.19 / EOL 2027-11-11。現行メジャーは 18。
